standard_prerequisites.use: The normalization of a normal space is itself.

core_obligations: The birational morphism f: Y -> X induces a morphism of normalizations over the dense open.
X normal means X equals its normalization; the induced morphism is f itself.
A finite birational morphism toward a normal scheme is an isomorphism over the scheme case; conclude f is an isomorphism over the normal locus.
proof_roadmap: Induced morphism; identification with f; scheme-case finish.
difficulty_reason: A three-step argument; the content is the identification of the normalization morphism with f.
